channel.title: ArcadeWebsite: featured games
channel.description: Featured free online games on ArcadeWebsite.

item.title: Pac-Man
item.description: Pac-Man is a light casual game you can enjoy in a few minutes at a time.

item.title: Slope
item.description: Slope is an endless 3D running game where you steer a ball down a neon track that gets faster the longer you survive. Gaps, ramps and red blocks appear without warning, so every run is a test of reflexes.

item.title: 1v1.LOL
item.description: 1v1.LOL is a third-person building and shooting game. Build walls, ramps and floors in a second to gain the high ground, then out-aim your opponent in quick battles.

item.title: 8 Ball Pool
item.description: 8 Ball Pool is a pool game: sink your group of balls, solids or stripes, then the 8 ball to win.

item.title: Among Us
item.description: Among Us is an arcade game built for quick sessions and one-more-try runs.

item.title: Happy Wheels
item.description: Happy Wheels is a ragdoll physics game where you ride wheelchairs, bikes and carts through deadly obstacle courses. It's known for its over-the-top crashes and huge library of user-made levels.

item.title: Slope 3
item.description: Slope 3 continues the fast-rolling formula of Slope with new track layouts and tighter turns. The ball keeps speeding up, so a single late move ends the run.

item.title: Slope 2 Player
item.description: Slope 2 Player puts two balls on the same speeding track so you can race a friend on one keyboard. Whoever stays on the course longest wins the round.

item.title: Run 3
item.description: Run 3 sends a small grey alien running through tunnels floating in space. Walls become floors as you rotate the tunnel, and the game mixes an endless mode with a long story of hand-built levels and unlockable characters.

item.title: Run 2
item.description: Run 2 is the second game in the Run series: guide the alien through space tunnels full of holes, rotating the tunnel to find solid ground.

item.title: Run
item.description: Run is the original space-tunnel runner that started the Run series. Run along the walls of a floating tunnel and jump over the gaps.

2048 is the classic number puzzle: slide numbered tiles on a 4×4 grid, and when two tiles with the same number touch, they merge into one. Keep combining until you build a 2048 tile, or go further for a high score.

item.title: Moto X3M
item.description: Moto X3M is a stunt bike racing game with short, obstacle-packed levels full of loops, ramps, saws and explosives. Finish fast for three stars, and flip in the air to cut time off the clock.

item.title: Moto X3M 2
item.description: Moto X3M 2 adds new tracks and tougher stunts to the stunt bike series, with more traps and timed jumps to master.

item.title: Moto X3M 3
item.description: Moto X3M 3 brings another set of stunt bike levels with new obstacles and bike unlocks.

item.title: Moto X3M Pool Party
item.description: Moto X3M Pool Party takes the stunt bike series to a summer setting full of pools, slides and inflatables.

item.title: Moto X3M Winter
item.description: Moto X3M Winter is the snowy edition of the stunt bike series, with icy ramps and Christmas-themed traps.

item.title: Moto X3M Spooky Land
item.description: Moto X3M Spooky Land is the Halloween edition of the stunt bike series, with haunted tracks, pumpkins and graveyards to race through.

item.title: Fireboy and Watergirl
item.description: Fireboy and Watergirl in the Forest Temple is a co-op puzzle platformer. Guide both characters to their exits: Fireboy can cross lava but not water, Watergirl can cross water but not lava, and both are stopped by green goo.

item.title: Fireboy and Watergirl 2
item.description: Fireboy and Watergirl 2: The Light Temple adds light beams and mirrors to the co-op puzzle series. Redirect the light to open doors while keeping each character away from the wrong element.

item.title: Fireboy and Watergirl 3
item.description: Fireboy and Watergirl 3: The Ice Temple introduces slippery ice and freezing water, so both heroes have new hazards to work around together.

item.title: Fireboy and Watergirl 5
item.description: Fireboy and Watergirl 5: Elements combines the hazards from the earlier temples into one adventure across several themed areas.

item.title: Fireboy and Watergirl 6
item.description: Fireboy and Watergirl 6: Fairy Tales brings the co-op duo into a fairy-tale world with new puzzles built around teamwork.

item.title: Papa's Pizzeria
item.description: Papa's Pizzeria is the time-management cooking game where you run Papa Louie's pizza shop. Take orders, add toppings in the right places, bake for the right time and slice it the way each customer wants.

item.title: Papa's Burgeria
item.description: Papa's Burgeria puts you in charge of Papa Louie's burger restaurant. Grill patties to the right doneness, build each burger in the order the customer asked for, and keep the line moving.

item.title: Papa's Freezeria
item.description: Papa's Freezeria is a cooking game set in an island sundae shop. Pick the cup, blend the flavors and add whipped cream, sauces and toppings exactly as ordered.

item.title: Papa's Taco Mia!
item.description: Papa's Taco Mia! has you running a taco restaurant: cook meats, assemble the shells and add toppings and sauces in the order each customer requests.

item.title: Papa's Cupcakeria
item.description: Papa's Cupcakeria is a bakery cooking game. Bake cupcakes, frost them and decorate them with toppings for seasonal orders.

item.title: Papa's Pancakeria
item.description: Papa's Pancakeria is a breakfast cooking game where you flip pancakes, French toast and waffles and pour drinks for a busy morning crowd.

item.title: Papa's Sushiria
item.description: Papa's Sushiria lets you run a sushi restaurant: cook the rice, roll the fillings, cut the rolls and serve them with bubble tea.
